note: Surveillance rules (PLAN WS-E, appendix A.6). A rule exists only where a guideline or consensus statement says so; its source was fetched and the quote copied verbatim. `when` (all must hold): age_min, lab_measured (trait_map analyte key), readout {id, value}, concordance_class {analyte, class}, clinvar_gene. `action.interval`: weeks or "once". Before `la.py surveillance plan` applies a rule, its source.url must have been fetched in the workspace with `la.py evidence fetch`; `la.py validate` checks the same. APOE e4: no guideline found that changes a screening interval by genotype, so no rule; it stays a question for the physician.

source.title: Lipoprotein(a) in atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease and aortic stenosis: a European Atherosclerosis Society consensus statement
source.locator: section 'Lipoprotein(a) testing', subsection 'Who should get an Lp(a) test?'
source.quote: Lp(a) should be measured at least once in adults, preferably in the first lipid profile, to identify those with high cardiovascular risk.
source.quote_note_locator: box 'Consensus key points: Influence of genetics and ethnicity on Lp(a)'
source.quote_note: Lp(a) concentration is predominantly determined by genetics (>90%), more than any other lipoprotein.
